### 4-Hour AI System for C-Level Executives

A free, proven path to clarity: **Workshop → Scorecard→ Discovery Sesssion**. Designed for C-Level executives who have a sense of urgency to adopt AI, a desire to learn more, and need to decide where to focus their energy and resources.

1. Join the **C-Level AI Workshop**, a free hands-on keyboard training session.

2. Take 5-minutes to complete the **AI Readiness Scorecard.**

3. **Book a free 1-to-1 discovery session** to uncover the use cases that will drive ROI.


## **C-Level** **AI** **Workshop**

The practical, hands-on course for senior executives to build the skills, vision and strategy to become the Chief AI Evangelist for their organization. During this mini-course, you will learn how to:

- Create a profile based on your preferred communication style.

- Wire ChatGPT to your voice.

- Stand up a Board of Advisors that pressures tests and challenges your strategic decisions.

- Run your first Board of Advisors session with a mock case study.


![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/68488bfd173fc83bd35b3d01/b35d07b9-baa8-4808-ab15-6938652b7aa9/PNG+C-Level+AI+Toolkit+%281%29.png)

[Sign-Up for the free mini-course](https://clevelai.found42.com/)

## **Industry** **Prompt Packs**

**Industry** **Prompt Packs** are designed to move workforce AI usage from novelty to mastery. They solve the "Depth Deficit" by replacing generic training with role-specific tools, ensuring teams move beyond basic summaries to create high-value deliverables.

A comprehensive set of 200 **industry-specific prompt packs (100 prompts/ industry for a total of 20k prompts)** that operationalize Gen AI for distinct job functions.

- **Role-Specific Precision:** Tailored content for **20 distinct job functions** (e.g., Sales vs. Engineering), recognizing that different roles require different inputs.

- **Deliverable-Focused:** Contains **100 prompts per library**, reverse-engineered from actual work outputs rather than abstract concepts.

- **Immediate Utility:** Helps solve the post-training adoption problem by giving employees the exact syntax and structure needed to execute specific tasks with AI immediately.


This is a part of an **AI** **deployment kit**. It eliminates the "blank stare" during adoption and empowers employees to apply AI directly to their core KPIs, deliverables, and deadlines.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/68488bfd173fc83bd35b3d01/77e38599-2a50-4896-8712-3644c15c75cf/ChatGPT+Image+Jan+11%2C+2026%2C+11_08_03+AM.png)

[Get your free prompt pack for your industry](https://www.found42.com/industryprompts)

![Overlapping digital scorecards displaying AI readiness assessment, including overall score of 70%, report overview, key metrics, and recommendations.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/68488bfd173fc83bd35b3d01/4b2b5ec3-a96b-4161-94c1-d9f041a415d3/High+Res+-+AI+Readiness+PDF+Example+Image+%281%29.png)

## **AI Readiness Scorecard**

This free AI Readiness Scorecard provides instant, actionable steps on how to drive ROI from your AI investments. Gain personalized insights and actionable steps to enhance productivity and unlock your business potential.

- It takes less than 5 minutes.

- It’s completely free.

- Receive personalized results and recommendations instantly.


[Get Your Free AI Readiness Scorecard](https://found42.io/)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/68488bfd173fc83bd35b3d01/5ad6542d-7f04-4c4a-b9ce-6ad6b6772071/Discovery+Session.png)

## **C-Level** **AI** **Discovery**

How can you move your team from “AI Explorer” mode to driving impact?

The **C-Level** **AI** **Discovery Session** is where strategy meets execution.

Using the training workshop and Scorecard as a baseline, we surface AI opportunities that deliver fast ROI, streamline operations, and unlock new growth. Leaders walk away with clarity, alignment, and a practical action plan .

[Learn More](https://www.found42.com/contact)

## Our Services

- #### 1\. AI Empowerment Training






Give your team the skills to think like leaders and automate their own work. Hands-on training builds an AI-first culture, tailored to your industry.

- #### 2\. AI-Powered Automation






We work with your team to pinpoint the three workflows with the highest ROI. Then we automate them to deliver over 3x returns.

- #### 3\. AI Product Differentiation for B2B SaaS






We help SaaS companies stand out by embedding AI capabilities that unlock new value for customers. From smarter workflows to entirely new features, we co-design AI-driven differentiation that accelerates revenue growth.

### **How it works**

Discover how AI can revolutionize your small business operations. Take less than 5 minutes to answer a series of yes/no questions about your current use of AI, and we'll share a free PDF report that provides a scorecard with recommendations on what to do next.

The questions are designed to create a high-level overview of your current state, including:

- Current Tools Usage
- Data Management Practices
- Workflow Efficiency
- AI Integration Readiness
- Automation Goals

## Why We Built This

Most business owners know AI matters. What they don’t know is where to start, what’s worth investing in, or how to cut through all of the hype.

That’s why we created the **AI Readiness Scorecard**.

This isn’t a gimmick or a trend-chasing quiz. It’s a fast, focused diagnostic that shows you:

- How prepared your business really is to harness AI
- Where you're losing time, money, or competitive edge
- What quick wins you can implement right now
- Which systems need upgrading for long-term, AI-powered growth

In under 5 minutes, you’ll receive a personalized report with insights and clear next steps. The goal is to replace uncertainty with confidence and help you take action that actually moves the needle.
